title: Infoblox Exchange 2026 - Bengaluru
audience: Networking, security and cloud leaders and practitioners
description: Day-long Infoblox customer event on unifying networking, security and cloud, with an executive keynote, focus sessions on visibility and preemptive security against GenAI threats, roundtables and bring-your-own-laptop hands-on labs.

title: Gitar Workshop Bangalore: Avoid engineering burnout with AI code review
description: Hands-on Sonar workshop on AI-driven development challenges and agentic workflows, showing how Gitar reviews PRs, auto-fixes issues and runs custom policies and workflows. Bring a laptop and GitHub account.

title: Atlassian Team on Tour: Bengaluru
audience: Mid-to-senior leaders at current and prospective Atlassian customers
description: Atlassian's one-day world tour stop with keynotes, breakouts and an expo on AI-driven teamwork, Rovo and service management. Registration is closed (sold out).

title: CISO6 Cyber Security Summit, XII Edition - Bengaluru
audience: CISOs, CIOs and senior security decision-makers
description: Day-long summit for security leaders themed 'Securing the Future: Leadership, Resilience & Digital Trust', with panels on Zero Trust, cloud security and cyber risk plus one-to-one meetings. Third-party organiser, not a vendor; an aggregator lists 12 Dec but the official page says 11 Dec.
